Remaining gap is undocumented in code, and C ignoring its own parameter looks like a C-side bug. DIRECTION NEEDS DECISION: (a) Rust always-omits CF on protected responses (match C as-is), or (b) fix C to emit CF on protected responses (coap_oscore_protect_response signature change).
